basics.name: Thanh Nguyen
basics.summary: Applied mathematician (M.Res., HCMUT, VNU-HCM) working on probabilistic machine learning and generative modeling (diffusion models, score and flow matching, optimal transport) and on robust learning under weak supervision. Seeking an AI research internship or research scientist role.

work.summary: Robust CTC training under noisy transcripts; manuscript submitted to IJCAI 2027.
highlights: Developed AlignBC, a training-only framework adding alignment-weighted bounded costs to CTC-family objectives using posterior or unbalanced OT plans, without changing the decoder or inference.

Derived closed-form gradient updates and proved a mass-sensitivity factorization; significant WER reductions in 7 of 8 CRNN-based STC/OTC comparisons on IAM and UIT-HWDB under synthetic transcript noise (five seeds; Holm-corrected tests).

work.position: Capacity-Dependent Theory for Kernel Score Estimation
highlights: Introduced a derivative-weighted effective dimension for kernel score estimation, giving capacity-dependent rates beyond capacity-independent bounds.
Proved an exact derivative penalty for diagonal and curl-free torus kernels and a matching minimax lower bound, with guarantees at every diffusion time.

work.company: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT), VNU-HCM
highlights: Generative models (2025-2026): proposed objectives unifying KL, score and flow matching, and an OT-improved score flow matching objective (2 journal papers, M.Res. thesis).
Bayesian optimization (2024-2025): benchmarked Bayesian optimization for hyperparameter search.
Extracted and cleaned ERP operational and sales data.
Built Power BI dashboards for revenue, production and sales monitoring; supported an approximately 5% reduction in excess inventory.
